parameters.description:
`fcm-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `fcm` payload. The gateway composes the upstream FCM URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters (the `api_key_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding this enrollment's API key).
parameters.summary: Relay a push message through your own FCM (legacy) account by posting a native `fcm` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's API key
